# Supported beds

<!-- Generated by tools/sync_adjustable_bed.py; do not edit. -->

HomeKit Adjustable Bed is checked against [Adjustable Bed](https://github.com/kristofferR/ha-adjustable-bed) **v5.0.0** ([`dc0167a`](https://github.com/kristofferR/ha-adjustable-bed/commit/dc0167a19ed5ebae08abc3d6a7accdf7c5fd593e)). Every bed type below works: HomeKit Adjustable Bed reads the entities Adjustable Bed creates for your bed, so a bed only gets the controls it really has. See [Detection](DETECTION.md) for the rules.

## Controls (1122 entity keys)

Per group of the form, the number of entity keys (side variants count separately) and how they are recognized: by a rule, by a word in the key (a vendor control without a rule, off by default) or only by its domain (off by default, under Settings).

| Group | Keys | Rule | Keyword | Domain only | On by default |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Adjustable sections | 464 | 154 | 310 | 0 | 142 |
| Quick actions | 69 | 33 | 36 | 0 | 24 |
| Massage | 184 | 30 | 154 | 0 | 9 |
| Lighting | 81 | 9 | 72 | 0 | 4 |
| Climate | 24 | 13 | 11 | 0 | 7 |
| Firmness | 13 | 3 | 10 | 0 | 3 |
| Settings | 287 | 2 | 72 | 213 | 0 |

HomeKit types: push button 677, slider 267, switch per option 92, switch 77, fan (climate) 6, lamp 2, fan 1.

Timed adjustments (`adjustable_bed.timed_move`): `axis_1`, `axis_2`, `axis_3`, `lumbar_tilt`, `tv_lift`, `back`, `right_back`, `legs`, `head`, `feet`, `both`, `neck`, `tilt`, `lumbar`, `bed_height`, `elevate`, `stair`, `m1x12_part_1`, `m1x12_part_2`, `m1x12_part_4`, `m1x12_part_8`, `m1x12_part_16`, `elevate_actuator_1`, `elevate_actuator_2`, `elevate_both`.
